We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm typical for CH3. Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to decide which tool to use. Probably get proton NMR spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no parameters). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No arguments. So it will return spectra for the sample at hand (the unknown compound). Let's call it.
